chapter: California, New York and Richard Himber
title: Recording with Richard Himber
summary: Hirsch discusses xylophone parts and an album crediting him with Himber.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did you ever record on xylophone? Uh... Background music, just background things. There's a xylophone player with Prima. Yeah.
And I don't know who else in the band would have played xylophone. Yeah, that was xylophone. Yeah. Yeah, I can't remember which one it was. He should come up to Tulane or something. Yeah.
Uh... There's only a couple sides, you know.
I'll tell you what I got, I just got a... I just had an album sent to me of Richard Hember's band and my name is mentioned on it. Oh, that's right.
It's... I'll do about eight bars or something on...
Well, you ought to see the books that mention you've been Hember. Uh... You know, there's a couple of pages in books that list the... Yeah. Yeah.
tunes that you recorded with them by the day the people were working.
Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. You weren't there for just a day, obviously.
